gaps.title: Platform tickets accept cross-tenant child entity references
gaps.tenantContext: tenantId supplied to platform ticket action
gaps.databaseMutation: creates or updates ticket rows with supplied linked ids
gaps.statusBeforeAfter: new/open ticket with arbitrary linked child ids
gaps.eventOutboxNotification: ticket audit/notification path, ownership not proven
missingTests: child entity ids must belong to selected tenant
gaps.defect: The action accepts tenantId plus subscription/domain/support/audit ids without validating that each child belongs to the same tenant.
gaps.reproduction: Create a platform ticket for tenant A and submit a domain/subscription/support grant id from tenant B; source allows persisting the misleading relationship.
gaps.recommendedChange: Validate ownership for every linked id and add DB-level constraints where practical.

gaps.title: Archived tenants can be reactivated by direct server action
gaps.databaseMutation: updates lifecycle/active flags
gaps.statusBeforeAfter: archived -> active possible by direct action; archivedAt remains
missingTests: direct-action archived tenant reactivation denial
archive metadata cleanup policy
gaps.defect: UI hides reactivation for archived tenants, but the server action does not enforce a current-status transition guard.
gaps.reproduction: Invoke the lifecycle action with action=reactivate for an archived tenant id.
gaps.recommendedChange: Replace free-form lifecycle action strings with explicit allowed transitions and make archived terminal unless a dedicated restore flow clears archive metadata.

gaps.title: Platform sector disable omits task-code usage
gaps.databaseMutation: disables tenant sector
gaps.statusBeforeAfter: sector enabled -> disabled while task code can still reference it
missingTests: platform sector disable blocks task-code references
gaps.defect: Platform disable guard checks some usage but not task codes, while tenant self-service guard includes task-code usage.
gaps.reproduction: Create a task code for sector S, then disable S through platform tenant detail.
gaps.recommendedChange: Share one sector usage counter between platform and tenant paths, including task codes.

gaps.title: Platform notification dispatch delivery is unproven
gaps.databaseMutation: materializes dispatch and recipient rows
gaps.statusBeforeAfter: draft/scheduled dispatch -> persisted rows
missingTests: dispatcher or worker consumes platform notification dispatches
gaps.defect: Source evidence proves persisted dispatch rows, not delivery or queue consumption.
gaps.reproduction: Create a dispatch and inspect source path; no proven sender/worker was found in this audit.
gaps.recommendedChange: Implement/verify a dispatcher or document the feature as scheduled-only messaging.

gaps.title: Assignment planning and direct mutation actions miss tenant predicates
gaps.tenantContext: permission check only; initial assignment/round lookup lacks current tenant predicate
gaps.databaseMutation: inserts interest rounds/responses, updates schedule/date/time, approves, or deletes assignment rows
gaps.statusBeforeAfter: assignment plannable/scheduled/review -> interest invited/rescheduled/plannable/deleted
gaps.eventOutboxNotification: domain events, personnel notifications, push worker
missingTests: cross-tenant server action invocation for poll/reminder/reschedule/reshift/approve/delete
gaps.defect: A user with planning or assignment write access in tenant A can supply tenant B assignment or round ids and mutate/notify/delete tenant B work.
gaps.reproduction: Call the affected server action with a valid assignmentId/roundId from another tenant.
gaps.recommendedChange: Call requireCurrentTenantId and include assignments.tenantId/round.tenantId predicates before any mutation or event.

gaps.title: Report approval can notify customer while invoice proposal creation failed
gaps.databaseMutation: report submitted -> approved; assignment report_submitted -> report_approved/invoice_ready when proposal succeeds
gaps.statusBeforeAfter: report submitted -> approved; assignment may not get invoice proposal after catch
gaps.eventOutboxNotification: report_approved and report_available_to_customer can emit even after proposal failure
missingTests: invoice proposal failure blocks or compensates customer notification
gaps.defect: Invoice proposal creation failure is caught/logged while approval continues and may notify the customer.
gaps.reproduction: Make createInvoiceProposalForAssignment throw after report approval update; action returns success with no proposal.
gaps.recommendedChange: Make approval/proposal/notification transactional or emit an explicit finance exception and suppress customer availability notification on proposal failure.

gaps.title: Invoice proposal helper lacks tenant boundary
gaps.actor: report approval or future helper caller
gaps.databaseMutation: reads assignment and creates/updates invoice proposal state
gaps.statusBeforeAfter: report_approved -> invoice_ready path
missingTests: helper enforces tenantId internally
gaps.defect: A direct import/reuse with a cross-tenant assignment id can mutate another tenant's finance state.
gaps.reproduction: Call helper from a tenant-scoped path without passing/enforcing tenantId.
gaps.recommendedChange: Require tenantId parameter and apply it to every assignment/invoice read and update.

gaps.title: Backoffice assignment status override has no workflow side-effect parity
gaps.databaseMutation: arbitrary canonical assignment status update
gaps.statusBeforeAfter: any allowed override status, including financial/terminal statuses
gaps.eventOutboxNotification: audit only; no mapped workflow events for most override states
missingTests: override side-effect matrix by status class
gaps.defect: Override can jump to states such as invoice_ready/closed without creating expected downstream records or notifications.
gaps.reproduction: Override scheduled assignment to invoice_ready or closed and inspect absence of workflow event/outbox.
gaps.recommendedChange: Define and enforce a transition side-effect matrix, or require explicit no-side-effects override reason.

gaps.title: Personnel PWA report submission bypasses workflow event/outbox
gaps.permissionModule: assigned personnel; reports module gate not proven
gaps.tenantContext: getPersonnelIdentity instead of consistently using current host tenant
gaps.databaseMutation: insert reports.status=submitted and update assignment completed/not_completed -> report_submitted
gaps.statusBeforeAfter: completed/not_completed -> report_submitted
gaps.eventOutboxNotification: fire-and-forget direct email only; no report_submitted domain event/outbox
missingTests: submitMyReport emits report_submitted workflow event
insert/update transaction
gaps.defect: Backoffice can see DB state but durable notification/event consumers are skipped and insert/update are not transactional.
gaps.reproduction: Submit a report from PWA and inspect absence of report_submitted domain event.
gaps.recommendedChange: Wrap insert/status update in a transaction and call emitReportWorkflowEvent for report_submitted.

gaps.title: Personnel field actions can drift from current host tenant
gaps.tenantContext: some actions derive tenant from personnel row rather than requireCurrentPersonnelPortalTenantId
gaps.databaseMutation: field mutations under personnel-row tenant
gaps.statusBeforeAfter: various field statuses/material/report rows
missingTests: wrong-host denial for reports/materials/extra-work/messages
gaps.defect: Actions are not standardized on the current portal host tenant, allowing inconsistent host-context enforcement.
gaps.reproduction: Use a personnel identity associated with one tenant while invoking actions through a different tenant host context.
gaps.recommendedChange: Require current host tenant and personnel_portal module in all personnel mutation actions.

gaps.title: Extra work task-code catalog is not tenant scoped
gaps.databaseMutation: extra work can use task-code catalog data
gaps.statusBeforeAfter: active task codes returned without tenant filter
missingTests: extra work task-code list and submitted ids are tenant-scoped
gaps.defect: All active task codes can be returned and potentially used across tenants.
gaps.reproduction: Create task codes in tenants A and B; call personnel extra-work catalog for tenant A and inspect tenant B code exposure.
gaps.recommendedChange: Filter active task codes by current tenant and validate submitted ids against that tenant.

gaps.title: Offline queue is client-local and mostly lacks server idempotency
gaps.databaseMutation: queued mutations replay when a client is open
gaps.statusBeforeAfter: queued -> replayed or failed
missingTests: browser close/reopen replay
stale status replay
duplicate completion idempotency
gaps.defect: Closing the browser, clearing localStorage, or replaying after status drift can lose or fail work.
gaps.reproduction: Queue non-material mutations, close/reopen or change assignment status before replay, then observe failures/loss.
gaps.recommendedChange: Add durable server-side idempotency/mutation log and stale-state reconciliation.

gaps.title: Expired sent quotes can still be approved or rejected
gaps.databaseMutation: quote sent -> approved/rejected; assignment awaiting_approval -> plannable/review
gaps.statusBeforeAfter: sent + awaiting_approval -> approved/plannable or rejected/review
missingTests: expired quote approve/reject denied in UI and server action
gaps.defect: The action/UI do not block a sent quote whose validityDate is in the past.
gaps.reproduction: Create a sent quote with past validityDate and assignment awaiting_approval; call approveQuote or rejectQuote.
gaps.recommendedChange: Enforce quote expiration in the mutation transaction and UI action controls.

gaps.title: Customer assignment detail can expose draft invoice metadata
gaps.databaseMutation: none; read-side exposure
gaps.statusBeforeAfter: draft invoice remains draft but visible in assignment detail card
missingTests: assignment detail excludes draft invoices
gaps.defect: Assignment detail joins invoices by assignmentId without filtering to customer-visible statuses, while invoice list/detail/PDF do filter.
gaps.reproduction: Create a draft invoice for a customer assignment; assignment detail can show it while /klant/facturen does not.
gaps.recommendedChange: Filter assignment detail invoice joins to sent/paid/cancelled only.

gaps.title: Payment checkout creation is not atomic with local persistence
gaps.permissionModule: customer identity; finance module gate not proven
gaps.databaseMutation: creates payment/batch rows after Mollie checkout creation
gaps.statusBeforeAfter: sent invoice -> open payment checkout
missingTests: Mollie-created/local-persist failure reconciliation
batch idempotency
gaps.defect: A DB failure after external Mollie checkout creation can leave an orphan checkout or partial batch.
gaps.reproduction: Force DB insert failure after Mollie checkout is created in payment action.
gaps.recommendedChange: Use transaction-safe local intent before external checkout or add idempotent reconciliation for external-created/local-failed cases.

gaps.title: Synthetic customer notifications cannot be marked read or deleted
gaps.databaseMutation: mark-read/delete updates only persisted customer_notifications
gaps.statusBeforeAfter: synthetic item remains readAt=null after mark-read/delete
missingTests: synthetic source-key read/delete reconciliation
gaps.defect: Pending quote/sent invoice synthetic notifications are regenerated as unread because no persisted read state exists for them.
gaps.reproduction: Mark a synthetic quote/invoice notification read or deleted, then reload notifications.
gaps.recommendedChange: Persist source-key notification rows or add per-customer synthetic read/delete state.

gaps.title: Mollie webhook payment settlement lacks tenant predicates and workflow event parity
gaps.permissionModule: Mollie signature; finance module and runtime tenant status guard not proven
gaps.tenantContext: payment/batch tenant exists, but paid invoice/assignment updates use ids without defensive tenant predicates
gaps.databaseMutation: payment open -> paid; invoice sent -> paid; assignment invoiced -> paid/closed, potentially through corrupted cross-tenant references
gaps.statusBeforeAfter: sent/open -> paid/closed
gaps.eventOutboxNotification: audit only; no invoice_paid workflow event parity
missingTests: webhook creates invoice_paid event and queue rows
manual and webhook path parity
gaps.defect: Webhook and manual mark-paid paths produce different event/cache/notification effects, and webhook paid branches do not defensively filter invoice/assignment updates by tenant.
gaps.reproduction: Settle via Mollie webhook and compare domain_events to backoffice markInvoicePaid; with corrupted batch/payment references, observe updates by invoice/assignment id only.
gaps.recommendedChange: Refactor webhook to call a tenant-scoped shared payment settlement finalizer and validate batch/payment invoice references against the payment tenant.

gaps.title: Payment reminder job ignores tenant runtime status and bypasses outbox
gaps.databaseMutation: sets lastReminderSentAt after direct email success
gaps.statusBeforeAfter: overdue sent invoice -> reminder timestamp updated
gaps.eventOutboxNotification: direct email only; no payment_reminder domain event
missingTests: suspended/archived tenant reminder denial
payment_reminder event/outbox
gaps.defect: The job checks finance entitlement but not active/suspended/archive runtime status and sends outside the durable event queue.
gaps.reproduction: Use a suspended tenant with finance included and an overdue sent invoice; job can send reminder.
gaps.recommendedChange: Add a runtime-active job tenant guard and emit a durable payment_reminder event.

gaps.title: Feature module gating is incomplete in customer direct routes/actions
gaps.permissionModule: layout requires customer_portal; feature-specific modules not consistently rechecked
gaps.databaseMutation: feature-specific reads/mutations can still execute through direct URLs/actions
gaps.statusBeforeAfter: module hidden in nav but action may remain available
missingTests: feature-disabled direct route/action denial for customer documents/reports/finance/notifications
gaps.defect: Navigation feature flags do not prove server-side feature module enforcement.
gaps.reproduction: Disable a customer-facing feature module and call its direct route/action.
gaps.recommendedChange: Add feature-module guards to route handlers/actions, not only layout/navigation.

gaps.title: Organization settings reads are tenant-ambiguous in notification side effects
gaps.routeActionApi: report and quote email side effects
gaps.tenantContext: missing or ambiguous organizationSettings tenant predicate in some side effects
gaps.databaseMutation: email side effects use settings row
gaps.statusBeforeAfter: workflow notification email prepared
gaps.eventOutboxNotification: direct email or workflow event depending path
missingTests: tenant-scoped organization settings lookup in quote/report emails
gaps.defect: Some report/quote notification settings reads appear to use the first org settings row instead of current tenant.
gaps.reproduction: Create multiple org settings rows and trigger report/quote email side effect; source does not prove tenant filter in affected paths.
gaps.recommendedChange: Require tenantId on every organization settings read used by tenant-scoped side effects.

gaps.title: Invite and reset flows mutate Supabase Auth before email delivery succeeds
gaps.actor: public password reset user, platform admin, tenant provisioning
gaps.routeActionApi: requestPasswordResetCode, platform invite/reset actions, tenant provisioning owner invite
gaps.permissionModule: public reset or platform admin depending path
gaps.tenantContext: request host or platform provisioning tenant
gaps.databaseMutation: Supabase password and app_metadata are changed before email delivery is proven
gaps.statusBeforeAfter: active auth user -> temporary-password/reset metadata state before email success
gaps.eventOutboxNotification: direct email path after auth mutation
missingTests: email failure leaves auth password/app_metadata unchanged
tenant owner provisioning email failure compensation
gaps.defect: If email delivery fails after the auth mutation, an account can be locked into a temporary-password/reset state without receiving the code.
gaps.reproduction: Configure email provider failure and request password reset or provision a tenant owner; auth metadata/password has already been changed before the action reports failure.
gaps.recommendedChange: Move to token-first invite/reset or add compensating rollback before reporting failure.

gaps.title: Temporary-password provisioning can overwrite active cross-portal accounts
gaps.tenantContext: platform user invite or tenant owner provisioning
gaps.databaseMutation: existing Supabase user password and app_metadata.portal can be replaced when allowExistingActive is true
gaps.statusBeforeAfter: existing active customer/personnel/tenant user -> temporary-password platform/tenant-admin identity
missingTests: existing active customer/personnel/tenant account cannot be overwritten by platform invite/provisioning
gaps.defect: The temp-password helper permits active account overwrite in platform invite/provisioning paths.
gaps.reproduction: Invite an email that already owns an active portal account through a path that passes allowExistingActive true.
gaps.recommendedChange: Remove or sharply constrain allowExistingActive and require a verified account-linking flow.

gaps.title: Tenant activity log is globally readable
gaps.databaseMutation: none; read-side exposure
gaps.statusBeforeAfter: global audit rows returned to tenant settings reader
missingTests: activity log only returns current tenant rows and explicitly allowed global rows
gaps.defect: listAuditLog does not call requireCurrentTenantId and does not filter auditLogTable.tenantId.
gaps.reproduction: Login as tenant A user with settings:read and open activity log; tenant B/global rows can be returned.
gaps.recommendedChange: Filter by current tenant and define explicit handling for tenantId null platform/global rows.

gaps.title: Backoffice personnel password reset accepts cross-tenant personnel ids
gaps.databaseMutation: managed reset/temporary access flow is triggered for supplied personnel id
gaps.statusBeforeAfter: foreign tenant personnel account receives reset flow
missingTests: sendPasswordReset rejects personnel ids outside current tenant
gaps.defect: Personnel lookup is by id only and does not include current tenant.
gaps.reproduction: Tenant A user with personnel:write submits tenant B personnel id to sendPasswordReset.
gaps.recommendedChange: Require current tenant and filter personnelTable.tenantId before reset side effects.

gaps.title: Personnel report submission inserts tenant-null reports
gaps.tenantContext: identity tenant used for assignment update but omitted from report insert
gaps.databaseMutation: inserts reports.status=submitted without tenantId and updates assignment to report_submitted
gaps.statusBeforeAfter: completed/not_completed -> report_submitted; report tenant_id remains null
gaps.eventOutboxNotification: direct email only; no report_submitted domain event
missingTests: PWA report insert sets reports.tenant_id to identity tenant
gaps.defect: Report workflow can recover tenant through assignment joins, but tenant-indexed consumers can miss or misclassify the report row.
gaps.reproduction: Submit a personnel report and inspect inserted reports.tenant_id.
gaps.recommendedChange: Set tenantId on insert and backfill existing null report tenants from assignments in a separately approved migration.

gaps.title: Customer document download signs raw stored paths
gaps.permissionModule: customer identity; documents module gate missing
gaps.tenantContext: document row is entity-scoped, storage_path is trusted directly
gaps.databaseMutation: none; signed URL creation
gaps.statusBeforeAfter: stored path -> signed download URL
missingTests: customer document signed URL rejects non-tenant-bound storage_path
gaps.defect: The action signs doc.storagePath directly instead of validating it with the tenant-bound storage path helper.
gaps.reproduction: Accessible document row with wrong-tenant/non-canonical storage_path can be signed.
gaps.recommendedChange: Validate storage_path with tenant-bound helper before createSignedUrl.

gaps.title: Customer notification preferences are persisted but not enforced by delivery
gaps.databaseMutation: preferences update succeeds; event delivery ignores those preferences
gaps.statusBeforeAfter: email/push preferences off -> delivery can still queue via global event settings
gaps.eventOutboxNotification: emitDomainEvent checks global event settings/customer email, not portal preferences
missingTests: disabled customer email/push preferences suppress delivery queue rows
gaps.defect: Customer can save preferences that are not consulted by notification delivery.
gaps.reproduction: Turn off customer email/push preferences, then trigger a customer event with email/push enabled globally.
gaps.recommendedChange: Enforce preferences in emitDomainEvent or a customer-recipient filtering layer.

gaps.title: Manual full-payment path lacks invoice_paid event parity
gaps.databaseMutation: payment/invoice become paid and assignment becomes closed
gaps.statusBeforeAfter: sent/open -> paid/closed
gaps.eventOutboxNotification: no invoice_paid event or customer-visible revalidation in full-payment path
missingTests: registerManualInvoicePayment emits invoice_paid event and refreshes customer-visible routes
gaps.defect: Manual payment path differs from markInvoicePaid and closes the assignment without event/outbox parity.
gaps.reproduction: Register a full manual invoice payment and inspect absence of invoice_paid domain event/customer notification.
gaps.recommendedChange: Use a shared paid-settlement finalizer for manual and webhook paths.

gaps.title: Domain event recipient lookups do not defensively enforce tenant membership
gaps.tenantContext: event has tenantId, recipient lookups are by recipient id only
gaps.databaseMutation: notification rows can be written for recipient ids supplied by caller
gaps.statusBeforeAfter: event tenant -> notification fanout
gaps.eventOutboxNotification: domain event and notification delivery queue
missingTests: emitDomainEvent rejects cross-tenant customer/personnel recipient ids
gaps.defect: Most callers validate recipients, but the shared API can fan out to a cross-tenant recipient if a caller passes bad input.
gaps.reproduction: Call emitDomainEvent with tenant A and a tenant B customer/personnel recipient id.
gaps.recommendedChange: Filter customer/personnel recipient lookups by both id and event tenantId.
